blocks.text: Paper Rex kicked off VALORANT Champions in Shanghai, China with a nail-biting performance, securing a hard-fought 13-4, 7-13, 13-10 victory over Team Liquid in the first match of the group stage, Thursday at the Jing’an Sports Center.
